output.summary: A cycad native to southern India and Sri Lanka, it is reported in the wild only from southern India and is the only gymnosperm among Sri Lanka’s native flora. An unreferenced account says its poisonous seeds can be made into flour for tortillas, tamales, soup and porridge after at least five water soakings.
output.edibilityNote: An unreferenced account says poisonous seeds are soaked at least five times, then dried and ground into flour used in several foods.
